reuse.why: Extends the existing getScheduledAmount and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.ts, the same tolerance the matcher uses, instead of re-deriving 7.5%.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; call sites only pass the op, and schedule-template.ts even drops its own isbetween dispatch in favour of the helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the single planning-amount function every planning path already calls.

scope.why: Only planning call sites, the helper, its tests and a release note; display-only callers are left alone.

maintainability.why: Clean single definition; the op is typed as a loose string and inserted before the positional boolean inverse, which is slightly fragile but easy to own.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, called with the op by schedules/app.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedule-template.ts, api-models.ts, computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and Balance.tsx.
